transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. Well, what brings me in is that I keep planning my days around not having to drive over those high bridges. I'll go out of my way to avoid them if I can. And if I really can't get around it and have to cross one, I just end up white-knuckling it the whole way across. I figured it was time to finally talk to someone about it.
Aside from high bridges, do you notice similar anxiety in other situations, like being in open spaces, large crowds, or far from home?

No, not really. It's just the high bridges. I don't have any problem being in open spaces, and crowds don't bother me at all. I travel for work sometimes, so being far from home isn't an issue either. It's really just the bridges that get to me.
